# Nharire Intelligence

> African-first Data & AI Intelligence SaaS Platform for High-Growth Enterprises by Nharire Data Group.
> Tagline: See Further. Know More. Decide Better.

Nharire Intelligence is an enterprise Data & AI SaaS platform developed by Nharire Data Group (Harare, Zimbabwe). Engineered specifically for African commercial environments, Nharire Intelligence addresses multi-currency volatility, informal market retail distribution, and fragmented supply chains through sovereign data infrastructure.

## Core Capabilities

- **Data Validation & Quality Profiling**: Automated ingestion of point-of-sale dumps, ERP extracts, mobile money ledgers, and operational CSV/JSON records. Evaluates schema cleanliness, detects outliers and anomalies, measures null rates, flags duplicate records, and computes a deterministic 0–100 Data Health Index.
- **Enterprise & Regional Telemetry**: Real-time operational monitoring and executive telemetry dashboards tailored for African trade corridors. Tracks SKU reorder velocity, cash versus mobile money distribution, regional FMCG depots, cold-chain temperature thresholds, and provincial performance across Southern and East Africa.
- **Grounded AI Analysis ("Ask Nharire")**: Zero-hallucination generative AI analysis powered by a deterministic two-tier pipeline. All numerical aggregations, sums, variances, and percentages are pre-computed server-side before synthesis, ensuring strict mathematical truth for executive and board decision-making.
- **Sovereign Data Governance & Security**: Strict tenant isolation across organizations and departmental workspaces. Customer data is protected with AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, and is never used to train public foundational AI models. Compliant with Zimbabwe Cyber & Data Protection Act, South Africa POPIA, Kenya DPA, and European GDPR.
